page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 24 physical cores and 24 vCPUs with a single thread per core configuration, operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance features no local storage and relies on network-attached storage, while offering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.hfg6.6xlarge demonstrates stable mid-range performance. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1282.13 GB/sec, which drops to 109.43 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a large block write speed of 48.03 GB/sec. The instance handles data processing tasks efficiently, as evidenced by a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 106.94 GB/sec and a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec. For database operations, it achieves a PassMark database score of 8647.45 and processes 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second.

Given its dedicated physical cores and high 3.1 GHz clock speed, the ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is well-suited for compute-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it a viable candidate for general-purpose applications, web serving, and medium-scale database hosting. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced resource density, providing dedicated CPU performance without the premium associated with specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. It is highly appropriate for software compilation, text processing, and small-to-medium language model inference, where it achieves 12.72 tokens per second for text generation on a 7B model.

It features 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs operating at 3.1 GHz, paired with 96.0 GB of RAM, which establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Performance benchmarks place this server in the average tier, with a PassMark CPU score of 23637.6 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 106.94 GB/sec. It also supports high-throughput database operations, delivering 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second. The ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is optimized for general-purpose workloads, web serving, software compilation, and medium-scale database deployments requiring dedicated CPU resources without local storage.
